mount.note: Emitted paths mirror the captured site's own absolute paths (e.g. `wp-content/uploads/x.jpg`), so a page's `/wp-content/...` reference and a stylesheet's `url(../fonts/x.woff)` both resolve without rewriting either the DOM or the CSS. Off-host files are namespaced under `external/<host>/`.

notes: Styles are listed in document order across linked and inline blocks; `order` is the position in that chain.
HTML and CSS are not rewritten. This map is the emitter's rewrite table, and emitted paths mirror the captured site's absolute paths so relative references keep working untouched.

Off-host references (Google Fonts CSS and its gstatic payloads) are captured under `external/<host>/`; their own absolute `url()` targets cannot be localised without rewriting CSS, which is forbidden by design.

Deferred CSS (cl-site-convert-mzi) is mirrored under deferred/<sha256>.css because it was captured after the chain was first built; the path is content-addressed, not a mirror of the source path, and the captured sheets carry no relative url() reference.
